accessDenied.title: Admin access required
accessDenied.description: The global glossary is a system-wide baseline applied to every workspace. Only platform administrators can view or edit it.

header.title: Global Glossary
header.description: System-wide terminology baseline applied to every workspace (unless it opts out). A workspace’s own glossary term always overrides a matching global term.

pagination.summary: Page {page} of {totalPages} ({count, plural, one {# term} other {# terms}})

createDialog.title: New Global Glossary Term
createDialog.description: Created as a draft — publish explicitly to make it live for every workspace.

editDialog.title: Edit Global Glossary Term
editDialog.description: Updates are audited and apply immediately when the term is published.

bulkImportDialog.title: Bulk Import (CSV)
bulkImportDialog.description: Headers: Term,Translation,SourceLanguage,TargetLanguage,BusinessDomain,Definition,UsageNote,Priority (only Term and Translation are required). Imported rows land as drafts.

auditDialog.title: Audit History
auditDialog.description: Who changed this term, and when.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Term?
deleteDialog.description: This removes <term></term> from the global glossary for every workspace. This cannot be undone from the UI.

validation.invalidLanguage: Choose a language the system supports, or leave it as All languages.
validation.termMin: Term must be at least 3 characters — short/common words risk hijacking every meeting's STT.

toasts.published: "{term}" published — now live for every opted-in workspace.
toasts.publishFailedDefault: Failed to publish term (a definition is required).
toasts.csvMissingColumns: CSV must include at least Term and Translation columns.
toasts.csvUnknownLanguages: Unknown language code(s): {codes}. Use {allowed}, or leave the column blank for all languages.
toasts.bulkImportIssues: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} had issues — check console.
